ops.oldText: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the twelve months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. Excluded Claims are not subject to any cap under this Section.

input.comment: [Playbook] We moved the cap to our standard position — the greater of twelve months' Fees and USD 1,000,000, applied mutually — because a one-month fee cap is far below any level that is meaningful against the committed spend. We also removed "without exception" so that indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement remain uncapped as Excluded Claims under Section 21.3.
input.summary: Replace one-month "without exception" cap with mutual cap of greater of 12 months' Fees or USD 1,000,000, excluding Excluded Claims.
